items.description: Ransomware operators are exploiting a Palo Alto Networks GlobalProtect VPN flaw to bypass multi-factor authentication and enter corporate networks. items.description: A short-lived change to AOMEI’s software update system gave hackers a way to deliver malware through a trusted route. Google Threat Intelligence Group (GTIG) and Mandiant found that attackers repeatedly altered AOMEI’s update settings for only a few minutes at a time between April and July 2026. items.title: Hackers Hijack Five OVHcloud CLI Releases to Distribute Secret-Stealing Malware
items.description: An attacker used a contributor's GitHub account to replace the download archives on five existing releases of OVHcloud's command-line tool on Monday, October 19. The account had been hijacked, and the new files were a build designed to steal secrets stored on the disk of any machine that runs it, the cloud provider says.
